scope: Distinct named GDI32.dll imports in PE files under test/binaries.

metafile: CreateMetaFileA/W records into a canonical 640x480 WAT surface; CloseMetaFile serializes a standard META_STRETCHDIB WMF and PlayMetaFile replays supported bitmap and vector records through the WAT rasterizer
PlayEnhMetaFile validates and replays EMR_STRETCHDIBITS; GetWinMetaFileBits and SetWinMetaFileBits preserve supported bitmap content across standard WMF/EMF streams
Classic WMF playback supports mapping, colors, ROP2, fill mode, SaveDC/RestoreDC, pen/brush creation-selection-deletion, lines, rectangles, ellipses, round rectangles, polygons, and polylines
Vector EMF records, WMF text/region records, and EnumMetaFile callbacks are not preserved; unsupported well-formed records are skipped during playback and raster conversion
printer: CreateDCA/W and PrintDlg allocate a WAT-owned 2400x3150 32-bpp page; StartDoc/StartPage/EndPage/EndDoc/AbortDoc enforce job ordering and each page begins white
Browser spool/export and persistent storage for every completed page are not implemented; the canonical bitmap retains the current page
SetAbortProc accepts but does not invoke the application callback; Escape and ExtEscape expose only the compatibility queries used by tracked applications
path: SelectClipPath consumes and combines canonical closed-path regions; general BeginPath/EndPath geometry recording is not exposed by the corpus API table
presentation: SetDeviceGammaRamp state round-trips but the LUT is not applied by the browser compositor
Pixel-format APIs expose one software RGBA format; OpenGL command rendering is outside GDI
fontPolicy: AddFontResourceA installs user-supplied NE .FON or standalone FNT 2.x/3.x bitmap strikes from the VFS; RemoveFontResourceA unregisters them
Browser and CLI preload the tracked W95FA FON; WAT lazily installs it and routes stock variable UI fonts plus common Win9x UI aliases through deterministic bitmap metrics and rasterization

WAT selects installed bitmap faces by name and rasterizes TextOut, ExtTextOut rectangle/lpDx semantics, and DrawText layout directly into canonical GDI pixels; unsupported formats and shaped/scalable text paths retain the Canvas fallback
GetFontData returns GDI_ERROR because raw selected-font table export is not implemented

GetGlyphOutlineA returns WAT-derived GGO_METRICS and DWORD-aligned GGO_BITMAP payloads for selected FNT strikes; scalable fonts retain Canvas metrics-only fallback, while native/Bezier/gray bitmap formats and transformed bitmap strikes remain unavailable
EnumFontsA shares the current deterministic single-face fallback enumeration
